description: SPOE's ship check on the project as it stands, free and with no AI: keys written in the code, SQL or shell commands built from text, raw HTML, cookies accepted from any site, routes that change data without sign-in, and what search engines will miss. The same check every export ships as check.mjs. A critical finding stops a publish until the owner confirms it, so fix those with write_files first.
name: check_project
title: Run the ship check
